observations.behavior: Adds a filter to exclude query error types listed in UNDISCLOSED_QUERY_ERROR_TYPES before joining them into the failure detail string.
observations.code_quote: disclosed_types = [t for t in self.query_error_types if t not in UNDISCLOSED_QUERY_ERROR_TYPES]
observations.posthog_connection: This could support a compliance or privacy mechanism where PostHog deliberately omits certain internal exception class names from the error message shown to warehouse export consumers, potentially to avoid revealing implementation details or proprietary exception handling. The exact set of undisclosed types and the rationale are not visible in this hunk.
